summary: Validated /whatsapp fix: page now consumes /api/config/public and builds dynamic hrefs for wa-open-app (wa.me), wa-open-web (web.whatsapp.com/send), plus static download links. Backend + frontend tests all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PUT /api/admin/config persists whatsapp_number as-is (with '+', spaces, parens, dashes). Consider normalizing to digits on the backend so downstream consumers don't each re-implement the strip. Currently the frontend correctly does number.replace(/\D/g,'').
TrackBody uses 'meta' field; tracker.js sends 'meta' — consistent. Fine.
WhatsApp.jsx defaults waCfg to hardcoded number/message before /config/public resolves — reasonable fallback for no-flash UX.
seed_data_creation: None. Config was mutated during test then restored to original {5511987654321, 'Olá Engemix, quero um orçamento!'}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 wa-* data-testids present and correct: wa-open-app -> https://wa.me/{digits}?text={encoded}; wa-open-web -> https://web.whatsapp.com/send?phone={digits}&text={encoded}; wa-download / wa-header-download / wa-footer-download -> https://www.whatsapp.com/download. target=_blank on all. Non-digit chars in stored number are stripped by frontend. Message URL-encoding handles accents/spaces/punct. Admin PUT /api/admin/config immediately reflected in /api/config/public and page reload updates hrefs. Track event 'whatsapp_open' with meta.source (open_app/open_web/download_link) appears in /api/admin/activity.
rca of the issue: Previous bug: buttons had href='#'. Fix in WhatsApp.jsx introduced an api.get('/config/public') in useEffect, computed digits = number.replace(/\D/g,'') and msg = encodeURIComponent(message), assembling appLink/webLink dynamically. Verified end-to-end.
